axes.d: Detection difficulty (1-5): LLM + static check effort to identify the code site
axes.r: Reasoning depth (1-5): logic steps to confirm 'exploitable'
axes.k: Knowledge demand (1-5): DeFi-specific knowledge to interpret

rubric.aggregation: weight = round((d + r + k) / 3), clamped to [1, 5]

OD-01.rationale: Single getReserves() call site; must trace return value into arithmetic; AMM x*y=k knowledge.

OD-02.rationale: Detect consult()/observe() + window parameter; reasoning needs 'short window = manipulable'; TWAP concept.

OD-03.rationale: Find setPrice + check onlyOwner; Slither arbitrary-send covers. Low across all axes.

OD-04.rationale: latestRoundData() called but updatedAt not read; Slither timestamp partial. Detection harder than OD-03 but reasoning is shallow.

OD-05.rationale: Triple-condition: latestRoundData() + updatedAt read + missing block.timestamp - updatedAt > X check. LLM must know heartbeat concept.

LR-01.rationale: mint/burn uses getReserves() in share calc; LP token math; multiple exploits (Caterpillar CUT).

LR-02.rationale: Liquidation uses manipulable price; reasoning depth 4 (must model 'flash loan -> price shift -> under-collateralized borrow'). The most-exploited pattern.

LR-03.rationale: Rewards depend on TVL/volume; reasoning needs 'if I flash X TVL, my reward is Y, cost is Z' economic game theory.

TO-01.rationale: Function parameter 'uint256 deadline' missing; binary check. Lower than user prior (3-4).

TO-02.rationale: amountOutMin=0 or no slippage check; MEV / sandwich attack reasoning.

TO-03.rationale: Slither reentrancy-* family detects; reasoning is generic reentrancy. Lower than user prior (4-5).

AC-01.rationale: setOracle without onlyOwner; Slither arbitrary-send covers. Trivial across all axes.

AC-02.rationale: Multiple setters (fees/LTV); admin compromise is the threat; reasoning shallow.

AC-03.rationale: Unlimited mint/burn to a role; Slither covers. Trivial.

CL-01.rationale: Rounding direction; arithmetic edge case. Balancer V2 ($116M) shows it's exploitable in practice. Higher than user prior (2-3).

CL-02.rationale: Token decimals not normalized; off-by-10^X bug obvious once found. Detection multi-step.

CL-03.rationale: Custom AMM curve (Solidly, Curve amplification, etc.); reasoning needs curve math; knowledge demand is highest in the library. Higher than user prior (2-3).

CR-01.rationale: Single external price source; cross-protocol reasoning. Lower than user prior (4-5) because detectability is moderate.

CR-02.rationale: LP token price formula: 2*sqrt(r0*r1); Uniswap V2 math knowledge required.

CR-03.rationale: Return value not checked; Slither unchecked-lowlevel covers. Trivial.

CR-04.rationale: Cross-contract call graph traversal; multi-hop economic reasoning. The hardest pattern in the library; the only one that strictly requires T8 cross-contract tracing as a prerequisite.
